Exercise: Single-Leg Hop Progression

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_jump

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- adductors
- calves
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- enhance_explosive_power
- improve_unilateral_stability_and_balance
- develop_quadriceps_strength

Contraindications:

- Recent lower limb injury or surgery
- Chronic knee pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Leg Hop with Medicine Ball, additional_equipment: medicine ball
- name: Single-Leg Hop with Resistance Band, additional_equipment: resistance band

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Single-Leg Box Jump, equipment: box

Instructions:

- Arrange a line of cones in front of you. Assume a relaxed standing position, balanced on one leg. Raise the knee of your opposite leg. This will be your starting position.
- Hop forward, jumping and landing with the same leg over the cone.
- Use a countermovement jump to hop from cone to cone.
- At the end, turn around and go back on the other leg.
